content: Hi, you look excited. What happened?

It's a lucky day for me. I not only got a chance to see the CBA, but get the ticket of Disneyland. And the most important thing to me is that a singing contest will be held in our school soon. I plan to take part in it.
Great! You have a good voice. By the way, are they giving prizes? I remember last time you got a pocket radio in the English contest.
It is said an ipad mini will be given as a reward to the first prize winner.
So cool. I bet you can get the first prize. Good luck!
